question: Worms of the Earth says lands can't enter the battlefield. If I cast Clone and choose to copy Dryad Arbor, a land creature, can Clone enter the battlefield?

expected.shortAnswer: No: Clone would enter as a land, so it can't enter the battlefield from the stack and is put into its owner's graveyard.
expected.answer: Worms of the Earth has the ability “Lands can’t enter the battlefield.” Clone says “You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield.” If a player casts Clone and chooses to copy Dryad Arbor (a land creature) while Worms of the Earth is on the battlefield, Clone can’t enter the battlefield from the stack. It’s put into its owner’s graveyard.
